claim_scope: continuous, discrete-token, and flow-chunk outputs can share one explicit executable action schema
coarse per-dimension tokenization introduces measurable action quantization error
a contract gateway rejects twelve hand-authored malformed packet classes
schema execution horizon, shared clock, field order, and monotonic command identity prevent specific metadata-bypass, replay, and out-of-order cases
a fresh generation timestamp does not replace explicit observation and first-action timestep binding

code.config: standard-library v3 mobile-base action schema and timestep-bound command gateway

limitations: two-dimensional mobile-base command rather than robot manipulation action
five-bin tokenization is a teaching example and not FAST or OpenVLA vocabulary
packets are hand-authored and no VLA or VLM API is executed
range/schema checks are not collision avoidance or functional safety
observation/action timestep equality covers one authored scheduling slot and does not establish clock synchronization or real queue timing
monotonic command IDs cover one process session and do not provide authentication, integrity, or reboot persistence
